sights.w: Portage County's oldest producers-only farmers market (1992), held Saturdays April-October under the Haymaker Parkway bridge between Main and Summit streets, with 25-40 vendors (produce, meats, cheese, maple, coffee, food trucks); moves indoors in winter. Covered by KentWired, Signal Akron's market guides, Akron Life and Cleveland Magazine's NE Ohio markets guide.

sights.address: Acorn Alley (off E Main St), Kent, OH 44240
sights.w: Pedestrian shopping lane (2009) built by Ron Burbick behind downtown Kent's historic Main Street storefronts, linking Main and Erie streets: local makers' shops, a cheesemonger, art studio and Laziza, its first tenant. In Cleveland Magazine's Downtown Kent guide, Akron Life's shop-local coverage and KentWired.
